title: Nine Letters and One Door
subtitle: 国家与公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：authority　|　正文 315 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 authority 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 my father wrote to ① an authority he could not name and got nine letters back, none of them from the same person. The ② authority, meaning the office and not the people in it, had nine rooms and no name on the door; an authority, he said, is the only correspondent who never signs its own letters. He said the signatures were all initials.

Every  authority he ever wrote to replied in the same handwriting, and he said that was the whole discovery. Their ③ authority for the water had nine rules and one tap that worked; an authority, my mother said, is the only thing that can say no without anybody having said it. She said the tap was in the yard for eleven years.

My grandmother meant the other thing: she said her mother had been ④ an authority on herbs, meaning somebody who knew. The ⑤ authority, meaning the knowledge and not the office, is the only kind that can be carried out of a room; an authority, she said, is either power or expertise, and the first is given and the second is earned. She said the earning takes nine years at least.

By 1971 the  authority had become a building and the building had become a queue. The ⑥ authority he quoted in the argument was a book, and my mother said that was cheating; an authority, my father said, is either the people who can stop you or the book that says they can. He said both had been wrong nine times.

The ⑦ authority I remember is the one with no name on the door, which answered nine times and said nothing once. An ⑧ authority, he said in 1977, is the only thing that is stronger the less you know about it; every authority, he said, is a machine for making nobody responsible. He said the machine was invented long before 1968.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 当局；官方机构（一个具体的部门）
B. n. 当局（指那个机构本身，与其中的人相对）
C. n. 当局（指管水的那一个）
D. n. 权威；专家（某方面的行家）
E. n. 权威；专门知识（抽象）
F. n. 权威；依据（指引用的那本书）
G. n. 当局（指门上没有名字的那一个）
H. n. 权威；当局（抽象总称；泛指）

items.q: an authority he could not name
The authority, meaning the office and not the people in it
The authority, meaning the knowledge and not the office
The authority he quoted in the argument

answers.why: authority 意为“当局、官方机构”，1968 年父亲给一个他叫不出名字的部门写信，收到九封回信，没有一封出自同一个人。
authority 指“那个机构本身”，与其中的人相对，它有九个房间，门上没有名字。
authority 指管水的那一个部门，他们管水的那个部门有九条规定和唯一一个能出水的水龙头。
authority 意为“权威、专家”，祖母说她母亲是草药方面的权威，意思是她懂。
authority 意为“权威、专门知识（抽象）”，与机构相对，它是唯一能被带出一个房间的那种权威。
authority 意为“权威、依据”，他在争论中引用的权威是一本书，母亲说那是耍赖。
authority 指门上没有名字的那一个，我记得的正是它：回复了九次，一次也没说出什么。
authority 为抽象总称，泛指“权威、当局这种东西”，他说权威是你了解得越少它就越强的东西。

他们管水的那个部门有九条规定和唯一一个能出水的水龙头。（authority）
祖母说她母亲是草药方面的权威，意思是她懂。（an authority on）
1977 年他说，权威是你了解得越少它就越强的东西。（authority）
